risk_note: RV2 (apps/api/src/modules/risk/**, app.module.ts; the withdrawal application and the auto payout decision). GATE-RISK-RULE-TOGGLE (D10-536 (b), D10-537, D10-564, D10-566). createBlocklistMatchReader reads the rule state BLACKLIST_<DIMENSION> before each dimension on the caller's handle: a disabled one is skipped and the next is looked at, the answer keeps its shape, a failed read rejects and never counts as disabled. Both production callers pass the reader: the application's 44001 and the decision's ⑨. No payout code changed: same_device_multi_account was already gated in risk's judgement by B1-03zh, and payout adds no second read (D10-566 ①), as pinned by the rule tests. Thresholds stay in config items; no schema or contract change. The ledger title still names the wider plan; it changes with the done commit (D10-537). Known and out of scope, reported to the orchestrator: production code never writes devices.user_id, so the device dimension does not match in production, before or after this change; the rule fixtures bind the device by hand.
